_comment: my-ai endpoints (my-ai-api on oci-apps 10.0.0.6, WG-only). Source of truth: cloud build.json ports. The agent is goose; the upstream is OpenRouter (NOT Claude). `proxy`/`api` both point at the my-ai-api app port (3217) — goose hits this as OPENAI_BASE_URL; the dash probes /readyz + /health here. `anthropic` is the upstream reachability probe target (OpenRouter base, kept for the dash 'direct' probe + future direct-fallback). `goosed` = goose ACP agent server (goose serve, X-Secret-Key auth, WireGuard-only) at port 3227.

setup._comment: goose installer (the agent for this stack). nix/termux = flake-managed (declarative); other platforms = goose releases. rescue = ephemeral nix-shell goose.

claude_profiles._comment: Claude Code context profiles. tokens = measured session preload via /context on 2026-07-30 (9 MCP servers, 4 cloud plugins). lean strips optional built-in tools/skills; full ships everything.

full.desc: all built-in tools + bundled skills (Workflow, Artifact, builtin agents)

lean.desc: optional built-in tools/skills disabled; loses Workflow, Artifact, bundled skills
